responsibility: Defines the main GCC target configuration header for Solaris 2 systems. It sets Solaris ABI type spellings including wchar_t/wint_t and stdint mappings, installs Solaris and SVR4 preprocessor builtins, configures assembler, linker, sysroot, multilib, PIE, and libgcc specs for Sun and GNU toolchains, enables Solaris-specific format checking and pragma/attribute hooks, and wires in backend helpers such as Solaris visibility handling, init/fini emission, and C++ mangling-context selection. Unlike sol2.cc, this header expresses Solaris policy mostly through target macros and spec strings.
same_name_distinction: This is the main Solaris configuration header in the sol2 group, expressing ABI choices, builtins, assembler/linker specs, and hook wiring; gcc/config/sol2.cc provides the out-of-line helper implementations behind several of those hooks, while gcc/config/sol2.opt is only option metadata.
